proposed_widenings.name: shared_charge_backed_spell_access_for_magic_items
proposed_widenings.justification: The current surface can either model shared item charges on an activation with one item-level activation cost, or model spell access passively with native spell casting times, but it cannot do both at once for one shared pool.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can press one of those faces, expend the number of charges required for it, and thereby cast the spell associated with it (save DC 17), as shown in the Cube of Force Faces table.

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall because the spell list mixes reaction, action, and minute-cast spells under one shared charge pool. Fixed DC 17 is representable; the blocker is the family shape.
